prompt:
Reference image 1 is the EXACT sprite to edit: Glitch, standing with both hands raised to chest height, operating a translucent floating holographic audio control panel (soft mint and lavender glow, sliders and track bars, no readable text), on a flat yellow background. Reference image 2 is the same character showing the facial expression to use.
Redraw reference image 1 keeping the same pose, hands, props, outfit, colours, proportions, framing, figure size and position in the frame, and the same art style. Change ONLY her face to this expression, matching the face in reference image 2: a small genuine laugh she rarely shows on stream: eyes gently closed, cheeks lifted, mouth corners up, mouth slightly open.
Sides must stay correct: the two hair clips, the thigh-high sock and the sling pouch are all on HER LEFT (the viewer's right).
GLITCH - IDENTITY. These features never change and never depend on which outfit she is wearing. The character is wrong if any of them is missing. For anything not spelled out here, the three-view model sheet is the authority.
- A small slim anime-style AI robot GIRL, the shorter of the two leads.
- Short gradient bob, cyber mint (#7cf3c0) fading into neon purple (#b78bff), with ONE long ahoge standing up from the crown.
- TWO pale grey bar-shaped ANTENNA DEVICES, one on each side of her head, each capped with a small mint/teal screen panel. They are hardware aerials, NOT animal ears and NOT cat ears.
- TWO dark bar-shaped hair clips on HER LEFT side of her head.
- Small solid pixel blocks in pink, mint and purple float in the air around her hair. They are part of her and appear in every image.
- Large teal-green eyes. Small square pixel blush marks on her cheeks.
- A dark choker.
- An oversized long-line iridescent pastel HOODIE with dark navy-purple horizontal stripes on the sleeves. TWO straps hang from the hood down the FRONT of the chest, one on each side of the chest print, each ending in a small square buckle.
- On the chest an ORANGE-RED ERROR PLATE carrying the letters ERROR sits ABOVE a grey cat face drawn as blocky 8-bit PIXEL ART made of square blocks. That cat face is a picture, NEVER a written character or word - do not replace it with any Chinese character.
- A large grey pixel cat face on the BACK of the hoodie.
- A dark device with a teal screen on ONE wrist.
- She wears NO hat of any kind and NO glasses. Her hair is never long, never a ponytail, never twintails.

GLITCH - OUTFIT B. The authority for this outfit is the desktop-pet sprite set (ai-brain-site images/pet.webp and images/pet-*.webp), which were checked against each other and agree on every item. No three-view model sheet exists for it: three attempts at one each contradicted the sprites on at least one item, so the sprites are canon instead.
- A dark charcoal PLEATED MINI SKIRT with lavender trim, worn under the long-line hoodie so the hoodie hem sits over its waistband.
- A SLING STRAP running from HER RIGHT SHOULDER down to HER LEFT HIP, carrying a small translucent holographic POUCH that rests on HER LEFT HIP.
- ONE dark THIGH-HIGH SOCK on HER LEFT LEG, with a thin garter band above the knee. Her RIGHT leg is bare and carries a small pastel adhesive bandage below the knee.
- Loose white ribbed LEG WARMERS bunched at BOTH ankles, sitting over the shoe tops.
- The same white-and-lavender high-top sneakers as Outfit A.
- The translucent iridescent loops still hang from the hoodie hem, one per side.
- Sides matter and drift easily: the hair clips, the thigh-high sock and the pouch are ALL on HER LEFT. Keep them together.
STYLE: identical art style to the reference sprite - clean anime line art, soft cel shading, the same colour palette and lighting, same level of detail. Full body from head to toe, the whole figure inside the frame with generous empty space on every side, nothing touching the image edges. Same scale as the reference sprite (the figure fills about 90% of the image height). No text, no watermark, no frame, no props other than those described.
BACKGROUND FOR CHROMA KEY: the subject stands on a perfectly flat solid #ffff00 (bright pure yellow) background for background removal. One uniform colour, no shadows, no floor, no gradient, no vignette, no reflection, no lighting variation. Crisp clean edges. Do NOT use #ffff00 anywhere on the subject. Vertical portrait 2:3.
